links.outcome: Calibration after local recalibration using real and synthetic-data-augmented local samples
links.effect: Urban center met sample guideline (Required 14,224, Available 42,303) and was best calibrated (α=0.1, β=1.05). Neither smaller site had enough samples (Site 1: 3187 of 16461; Site 2: 905 of 15299). Deep learning SDG most improved calibration.
links.quote: In the simulation study, deep learning-based SDG was most effective at improving calibration performance.

links.outcome: Local calibration of readmission model at three hospitals and sample sufficiency for recalibration
links.effect: Urban center had enough samples for recalibration (42,303 vs 14,224 required). Smaller rural sites did not (3187 vs 16461; 905 vs 15299), so they could not localize the model.
links.quote: For the smaller sites, neither site had the samples required for recalibration (Site 1: Required: 16461, Available: 3187; Site 2: Required: 15299, Available: 905).
